note: Every board Comet is released for, grouped by brand on cometmesh.org/boards.html. The site (boards page, installer), scripts/release.sh and the update check all go by this list: adding a board is one entry here plus its WADA_BOARD_ID in src/ui-touch/UITask.cpp. id = WADA_BOARD_ID (release images are comet-<id>.bin); build = {"idf": <idf/boards dir>} or {"pio": <PlatformIO env>}; status = main | supported | experimental; each feature is full | partial | untested | planned | none, with an optional note in feature_notes.
